en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, form Al Hassan Al Ataar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A man who slanders a people?’ Heasws said: ‘With one speech?’ I said, ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘He would be whipped one Penalty (Hadd). So if he had differentiated between them with regards to the slander, he would be whipped a Penalty (Hadd) for each one of them’.
